title: How do you find duplicate rows in a table?
description: Find duplicates with GROUP BY ... HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 and with window functions, and return the full duplicate rows.

title: How do you delete duplicate rows but keep one?
description: Delete duplicates while keeping the lowest id, using ROW_NUMBER, a self join or NOT IN over a grouped subquery.

title: What is the difference between NOT IN and NOT EXISTS when NULLs are involved?
description: Why NOT IN returns no rows when the subquery contains NULL, and why NOT EXISTS or an anti-join is the safe form.

title: How do you calculate a running total or moving average?
description: Running totals and moving averages with SUM/AVG OVER (ORDER BY ... ROWS BETWEEN ...), and the RANGE vs ROWS difference.

title: How do you solve gaps-and-islands problems in SQL?
description: Group consecutive rows (streaks, sessions, date ranges) with the ROW_NUMBER difference trick and LAG-based session starts.

title: What is SQL injection and how do parameterized queries prevent it?
description: How string-built SQL is exploited, why placeholders keep data out of the query text, and what parameters cannot protect (identifiers).

title: What is denormalization and when should you use it?
description: Trading write complexity for read speed: duplicated columns, summary tables, materialized views, and keeping them consistent.

title: What is a CROSS JOIN and when is it useful?
description: The Cartesian product, generating combinations and calendars, and the accidental cross join bug.

title: Does a filter in the ON clause behave differently from WHERE in a LEFT JOIN?
description: Why a condition on the right table in WHERE turns a LEFT JOIN into an inner join, and when it belongs in ON.

title: What are NOT NULL, DEFAULT and other column constraints?
description: NOT NULL, DEFAULT, UNIQUE, CHECK, PRIMARY KEY and FOREIGN KEY as column rules the database enforces.

title: What is the difference between OLTP and OLAP databases?
description: Transactional row stores versus analytical column stores: workloads, schemas (normalized vs star), and examples.

title: How do you calculate year-over-year or month-over-month growth in SQL?
description: Period-over-period growth with LAG over grouped periods, handling missing months and division by zero.
